title: Invoice Number Check
summary: Checks a GST invoice number against CGST Rule 46(b): 16 characters at most, only letters, digits, - and /, and unique in the financial year.
description: GST invoice number field that counts to 16, names characters other than letters, digits, - or /, catches a number already used this financial year (case-insensitively), a stale year token, skipped or reused counters and gaps, and offers the next number.
catches: Characters other than letters, digits, hyphen and slash
Number already used this financial year, including case-only differences and cancelled numbers
Financial-year token that doesn't match the invoice date
Skipped or reused counter and gaps in the series
limits: Only checks against the issued list you pass; numbers issued elsewhere are unknown
Case-insensitive duplicate matching mirrors portal behaviour as the authors understood it, not a rule text
Doesn't validate the rest of the invoice (GSTIN, HSN, tax)
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid on errors and is described by the hint
Problems are announced in a polite live region; icons are aria-hidden
Fix and next-number buttons are real buttons; focus returns to the input after applying
server: Allocate invoice numbers on the server with a unique constraint per GSTIN and financial year.

sources.label: CGST Rules, Rule 46(b) (CBIC tax information portal)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Confirmed: consecutive serial number not exceeding sixteen characters, letters, numerals, - and /, one or multiple series, unique for a financial year. The case-insensitive portal comparison and e-invoice specifics are not from the rule text and were not verified.

stops: Helps catch a GST invoice number the rules don't allow
